content_sections.heading: About IGNCA
content_sections.text: IGNCA is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India. It is based at Janpath Building, Janpath Road, New Delhi. It studies all the arts with a multi-disciplinary approach. Under its Adi Drishya (Primeval Vision) Programme, it researches the rock art of the country. The project aims to document, study and spread knowledge about these first creative expressions of early humankind and to preserve them for the future. Both posts work in this department.

content_sections.heading: IGNCA Project Associate and Project Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Post Graduate with at least 55% marks in the subject of Archaeology from a reputed University/Institute. At least 3 years of work experience with a reputed institution in archaeology (Field Archaeology). Good knowledge of computers. Good English and Hindi. Post Graduate with at least 55% marks in the subject of Ancient History & Archaeology from a reputed University/Institute. At least 1 year of work experience with a reputed institution in archaeology (Field Archaeology). Good knowledge of computers. Good English and Hindi. Check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Work Profile
content_sections.text: The work is the same for both posts: Field work: survey, documentation (anywhere in India), data consolidation and similar tasks. Workshops, exhibitions and seminars. Any other work the HoD (Adi Drishya Department) assigns from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by walk-in interview. Original certificates are checked first, when you report. Only candidates found eligible at this check can sit the interview. IGNCA may accept or reject any or all applications without giving a reason. Its decision on who is called for interview and who is engaged is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Both posts are contractual and last two years. Pay is consolidated: Rs. 40,000 a month for the Project Associate and Rs. 30,000 a month for the Project Assistant. Field survey and documentation can be anywhere in India. When you join, you must submit two reference letters or testimonials from a previous employer, organisation or institution where you worked or studied. They must have been issued within the past month.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGNCA Project Associate and Project Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and print the application form on its last two pages. Fill in the form. It asks for the post applied for, your personal and contact details, Aadhaar and PAN numbers, education in ascending order (year, university, % of marks, division), whether you meet the post's requirements, your employment history with pay details, and any additional information. Paste a recent passport-size photograph and sign the declaration. Go to the Office of HoD (Adi Drishya), 4th Floor, A1-Wing, IGNCA, Janpath, Delhi on 5 November 2026. Project Associate candidates report at 10:00 A.M. and Project Assistant candidates at 12:00 PM. Hand in your form before the cut-off time for your post: 11:00 A.M. for Project Associate, 01:00 P.M. for Project Assistant. Late forms are not accepted. Have your original certificates checked, then attend the interview if you are found eligible. Filled application form with photograph Updated resume Self-attested copies of all testimonials: academic marksheets (10th onwards) and experience certificates Original certificates for verification Original and a copy of an identity proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID or Driving Licence). This is mandatory.

faq.question: Q1. Where is the IGNCA walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: At the Office of HoD (Adi Drishya), 4th Floor, A1-Wing, IGNCA, Janpath, Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What time should I report?
faq.answer: Project Associate candidates report at 10:00 A.M. and Project Assistant candidates at 12:00 PM. Forms are not accepted after 11:00 A.M. and 01:00 P.M. respectively.

faq.question: Q3. What marks do I need in my postgraduate degree?
faq.answer: At least 55% marks: in Archaeology for the Project Associate post, and in Ancient History & Archaeology for the Project Assistant post.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is needed?
faq.answer: The Project Associate needs at least 3 years and the Project Assistant at least 1 year of experience with a reputed institution in field archaeology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: 40 years for the Project Associate and 35 years for the Project Assistant, counted as on 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No. Both posts are contractual and last two years.

faq.question: Q7. Which identity proof is accepted?
faq.answer: An Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID or Driving Licence. You must bring both the original and a copy.

faq.question: Q8. Will I have to travel?
faq.answer: Yes. The work includes field survey and documentation anywhere in India, as well as workshops, exhibitions and seminars.

faq.question: Q9. What must a selected candidate submit when joining?
faq.answer: Two reference letters or testimonials from a previous employer or institution where they worked or studied. The letters must have been issued within the past month.
